resources.string: Visual-only satellite status bar icon for Samsung One UI. No real satellite or emergency functionality.
Adds a dedicated visual-only slot in the Samsung status bar. Uses a built-in satellite icon without changing the actual network connection.
VISUAL SIMULATION ONLY\nNO ACTUAL STARLINK / T-SATELLITE / SOS ACCESS

Setup: enable Samsung SATIconEmul’ in LSPosed and scope it to System UI only, then reboot. If no icon appears, check LSPosed logs for SatelliteVisualNative. If SystemUI becomes unstable, disable the module and reboot. Samsung implementations differ; display is not guaranteed.
Classic AOSP satellite resources not found. Your One UI version may require separate compatibility checks.
